thread:
Ida: quick async — rolling a controlled rollout for ml-serving v2 today. started 2% canary to user-slice A at 14:02 UTC. will watch perf + error budget for 20m before ramp
Samir: saw it, perf dashboard looks stable so far. 95th latency +8ms on long-context tests, normal otherwise
Katie: small FYI: support ticket #3241 reported a 502 from region-eu-2 around 14:05 — not sure if related
Jordan: checking infra logs now. region-eu-2 had transient NAT gateway retries at 14:04, unrelated to model path but might affect some requests
Ida: thanks @Jordan. keeping an eye. deploy bot should post status once healthchecks pass
deploy-bot: Deploy 1717034567 by Ida -> redwood/ml-serving:v2 canary(2%) HEALTHCHECKS_PASSED
Samir: heads-up: found a fallback-path that still hits the old tokenizer in rare cases. PR opened: #2489. Recommend blocking further ramps until merged
Ida: linked and noted. can we patch quickly? how invasive is the change?
Samir: small change in routing layer ~15 LOC, unit tests in place. quick review needed
Katie: reviewing PR now, left one nit on test name. otherwise LGTM.
Chen: can we add decoder.err_rate to the canary dashboards and alert rule? saw a spike last week that escaped notice
Ida: good call — added decoder.err_rate to the canary board and set provisional alert at 0.5% for the ramp window
Jordan: infra will also pause autoscaler scale-down during canary window to avoid flapping impact
Ida: plan: hold at 2% for 20m, if errors <0.5% and latency delta <20ms, ramp to 10% then reassess. rollback criteria: errors >0.5% for 5m or p95 increase >40ms
Samir: SGTM :thumbsup:
Katie: merging PR now, will ping when deployed to canary nodes
deploy-bot: Merge PR #2489 by Samir -> branch: main = SUCCESS
Katie: PR merged and CI green, rolling out patch to canary pool (job 1717034999)
Ida: thanks — monitoring. will post follow-up after the 20m window
Jordan: noted, will keep autoscaler pause until you call resume
Chen: logging a quick note in runbook about decoder alert and rollback steps
Ida: perfect, thanks everyone. back in ~25m with verdict.
